# XY15: 线法墙 Xianfa Qiang, "Hsien Fa Picture East of the Lake"

3D: `/reconstruction/3d.html?b=XY15` · Page: `/xiyanglou#XY15` · Row: `research/buildings/XY15-xianfa-qiang/`

## What it was

An outdoor stage: pairs of walls set like wings, narrowing towards a back wall, with a European town painted across them, to be seen from the far side of 方河 (S02 pp.159-160). The plan calls it 线法画. The number of walls is not settled: five a side (S02), six a side on the plan, seven a side in S361, 11 in all on a Lei plan (S310, extract), about 5 on plate 20 (Q16). The paintings' medium is not settled either: "partly modeled and partly painted on walls" in Malone, hung pictures in S361; "oil on brick" has no source (material row).

## After 1860

Malone's photograph still shows walls like wings. Later dates were not found.

## Notes

<!-- Yours: regeneration never touches this part. -->

Round 30: a detailed model of the whole stage (`models/XY15-xianfa-qiang/README.md`): plate 20's two rusticated gates on the first pair of flats (each fits its own camera at 0.23 and 0.36 m; the plate draws them 17% apart in proportion, Q314), five more pairs of flats on S01's boxes cut to painted houses (assumed: the paintings are lost), the back wall, six steps down to 方河 on the axis (plate 20; five in the first count), the east shore of 方河 a stone quay. The whole plate fits one camera only at 1.51 m: it draws the stage shallower than the plan (Q313).
